get.description:
The events after a cursor. With wait, it answers once an event matches, or at the end of the wait with none.

Each read runs in the thread pool, in a session of its own. Between two reads the route awaits the database's
next wake and holds no thread. Each read starts at the cursor that the last one moved to, past what the filters
left out.

post.description: Develop a seed into a defined idea that the daemon can schedule.
Set an idea's status, with a note on the idea that says why.

put.description: Link an idea to another of its campaign: it runs after the target, or supersedes it.

AckOutcome.title: AckOutcome
AckOutcome.description: What an acknowledgement did to one id.

acked_by.title: Acked By
acked_by.description: Who acknowledged it: the caller, or whoever did before. Null for an id that is not in the inbox.

AckResult.title: AckResult
AckResult.description: What an acknowledgement did to one id.

Acked.title: Acked
Acked.description: What an acknowledgement did to each id, read at ``cursor``.

AnomalyNews.title: AnomalyNews
AnomalyNews.description: An anomaly that the daemon gave to a watchdog.

BaseBody.title: BaseBody
BaseBody.description: The candidate that an idea's runs start from. Null: no pin, the head when the run starts.

next.title: Next
next.description:
The cursor for the next read. It passes every event that the read examined, those that the filters left out
too, so a read that returns nothing still moves on.

more.title: More
more.description: Events newer than ``next`` exist already: read again without waiting. They may not match the filters.

CampaignAnswer.title: CampaignAnswer
CampaignAnswer.description: A campaign after a change, read at ``cursor``: the events after it are the effects of the change.

CampaignOverview.title: CampaignOverview
CampaignOverview.description: A campaign's overview: the sections of its ``[status] sections``, in order.

parent.description: The campaign that it is under. Null for a root.

paused.title: Paused
paused.description: What ``piloop pause`` holds: ``launches`` or ``all``. Null while the campaign is not paused.

head.description: Null when the campaign has no trunk keep.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: The baseline and the commits of runs, not the imported references.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: The number of ideas in each status.

runnable.title: Runnable
runnable.description: The ``ready`` ideas that no prerequisite blocks.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: The agents that are starting or running.

CampaignState.title: CampaignState
CampaignState.description: What ``piloop status`` shows of a campaign, as data.

CampaignStatus.title: CampaignStatus
CampaignStatus.description: Whether the daemon still requests work for a campaign. ``stopped`` after a ``[stop]`` condition held.

CommentKind.title: CommentKind
CommentKind.description: Why a comment was written. An ``escalation`` asks for a decision and is always in the human's inbox.

CommentNews.title: CommentNews
CommentNews.description: A new inbox item that someone else wrote.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Null for a comment that is not in the inbox.

CommentView.title: CommentView
CommentView.description: A comment, as ``piloop inbox show`` shows it.

started.title: Started
started.description: When it started, ISO 8601 in UTC.

listen.title: Listen
listen.description: The URL that it serves other machines on. Null when it serves only this machine.

DaemonState.title: DaemonState
DaemonState.description: The daemon that answers: its process, and where it listens.

review.title: Review
review.description: Why the idea waits for a review, as ``proposed`` although nobody asked: its author's role is held. Else null.

hypothesis.title: Hypothesis
hypothesis.description: The mechanism, and why it should move the metric.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: What supports it, with ids and paths.

check.title: Check
check.description: The cheapest measurement that can prove it wrong, and the result that stops the run.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: The expected size of the effect in the metric's units, and why.

title.title: Title
title.description: A clearer title. Default: the seed's.

DevelopBody.title: DevelopBody
DevelopBody.description: What makes a seed a defined idea: each field that the implementer needs.

Ending.title: Ending
Ending.description: How the daemon ends the agents of a stop or a cancel that someone requested.

id.title: Id
id.description: The cursor: events are read in id order.

time.title: Time
time.description: When the event was written, ISO 8601 in UTC. Null when the stored value is not a time.

payload.description: The payload as stored: any JSON value. Null when the stored value is not JSON.

invalid.title: Invalid
invalid.description: Only when a stored value did not read: the stored text of each such field, ``time`` or ``payload``.

Envelope.title: Envelope
Envelope.description: One event, as every reader sees it.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What the value counts, after it: ``h``, ``tokens``, ``USD``.

Head.title: Head
Head.description: The head of the trunk: the latest keep.

IdeaAnswer.title: IdeaAnswer
IdeaAnswer.description: An idea that a change wrote, read at ``cursor``.

hypothesis.title: Hypothesis
hypothesis.description: Why this should help, and by how much. Default: the title.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: What prompted the idea, with ids or a URL.

family.title: Family
family.description: The mechanism family. Ideas that try the same mechanism share it.

harness.title: Harness
harness.description: The harness to use instead of the rotation.

base.title: Base
base.description: The candidate to start from instead of the head. This makes a branch.

proposed.title: Proposed
proposed.description: Wait for a review before the daemon schedules the idea.

track.title: Track
track.description: The track it works on. Required when the campaign has more than one track.

after.title: After
after.description: The ideas to wait for. The idea runs from the head when all are done.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: The ideas that this idea refines.

IdeaBody.title: IdeaBody
IdeaBody.description: A defined idea, which the daemon schedules in priority order once it is ready.

IdeaStatus.title: IdeaStatus
IdeaStatus.description:
The lifecycle of an idea. The scheduler picks up ``ready`` ideas in priority order.

A ``seed`` is a rough idea with pointers. An agent whose role's ``files`` allows it files one (``piloop idea
seed``). Research develops it into a defined idea (``piloop idea develop``, which makes it ``ready`` or
``proposed``), or rejects it.
A ``proposed`` idea is defined and waits for a human to approve it.

IdeaView.title: IdeaView
IdeaView.description: An idea, as the change that wrote it left it.

items.title: Items
items.description: Most urgent first, then oldest first.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: An inbox item: a comment with a priority.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Markdown list items, ``- …``, with ``  - …`` for an item under the one before.

Lines.title: Lines
Lines.description: A list: one item per line.

LinkKind.title: LinkKind
LinkKind.description: How one idea relates to another in ``idea_links``: it runs *after* the target, or it *supersedes* the target.

LiveAgent.title: LiveAgent
LiveAgent.description: An agent that is starting or running.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who set the limit. Null unless ``origin`` is ``limit``.

LiveKey.title: LiveKey
LiveKey.description: A live key of a provider of the home (``piloop limits``), and where its value comes from.

Named.title: Named
Named.description: A campaign, by its id and its name.

next.title: Next
next.description: The cursor for the next wait. It passes every event that the read examined.

News.title: News
News.description: What needs the orchestrator after a cursor: what ends ``piloop inbox wait``.

OpenRun.title: OpenRun
OpenRun.description: A run that is queued or running.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: What ``piloop status`` prints: the daemon, the live keys that ``config.toml`` or a limit sets, and each overview.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, with ids: what the pause waits for.

evals.title: Evals
evals.description: Hold the measurements that the daemon starts too: after a new evaluator, or asked.

error.title: Error
error.description: A ``Problem``. Missing from a 404 of a route that the daemon does not have: it runs an older piloop.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description: Why a route refuses a request, with its status: a ``Problem``, and what to do.

Reasoned.title: Reasoned
Reasoned.description: A change to an idea, with why: it goes into the event or a note on the idea.

Rendered.title: Rendered
Rendered.description:
One section of what a reader sees: a title and its blocks (``piloop.plugins.section``).

A section provider returns it, the API answers it, and ``piloop status``, a brief and a UI render it.

Replied.title: Replied
Replied.description: The answer to an inbox item, read at ``cursor``.

ReplyBody.title: ReplyBody
ReplyBody.description: An answer to an inbox item: a ``decision`` on the root of its thread.

Seed.title: Seed
Seed.description: A seed that waits for research.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Pointers to what prompted the hunch: ids, paths or numbers.

base.title: Base
base.description: The candidate to start from, when the hunch is about that tree.

track.title: Track
track.description: The track it works on. Required when the campaign has more than one track.

SeedBody.title: SeedBody
SeedBody.description: A seed: a hunch with pointers, for research to develop into a defined idea or to reject.

SeedNews.title: SeedNews
SeedNews.description: A seed that someone else filed.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: What ``piloop status --json`` prints: the daemon, and each campaign read at ``cursor``.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for ``stopped_reason`` and the closing review.

ending.description: How the running implementers end. ``now`` also ends those of a stopped campaign that still wind down.

StoppedNews.title: StoppedNews
StoppedNews.description: A campaign that the daemon stopped.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description:
A ``TargetKind``: ``campaign``, ``idea``, ``run``, ``candidate``, ``measurement``, ``agent_session``, ``comment``, or
``home`` for an event about the whole home.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description:
The campaign of the row, resolved when the event is read. Null when the row is gone or has no campaign (a reply
to a reply). A campaign filter keeps these events too, because they may be of that campaign.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: The row that an event is about.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Each row has one value per column.

Target.title: Target
Target.description: The row that a comment is about.

Text.title: Text
Text.description: Markdown text: a paragraph, or a document with headings and tables of its own.

Thread.title: Thread
Thread.description: An inbox item, and the comments that it cites, that cite it, or that reply to it.

TrackBody.title: TrackBody
TrackBody.description: The track to move an idea to.

TrackChanged.title: TrackChanged
TrackChanged.description: An idea that moved to another track.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The primary metric of the track.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when the current evaluator has not measured the head.

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Against the baseline. Null when the head is the baseline, or either is not measured.

VerdictNews.title: VerdictNews
VerdictNews.description: The daemon's verdict on a measured candidate.
